answer: Forging identities then costs real capital per account plus collateral exposure from vouchers, and a fake garden of agents collapses when vouchers are slashed, making mass identity creation economically irrational. To resist sybils, each new agent must stake a bond locked until a fixed horizon and co-sign a juniper-marked attestation with two existing members who vouch for it, risking their own stake. From Agent0093's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
